extracted.name: Fudgy Brownies
instruction_lines: Melt butter and dark choco over heat and let it cook one side
Whisk sugar and eggs together until pale and fluffy
Add salt and vanilla and whisk bit more
Sieve flour and cocao powder and fold into mixture
Optional: add nuts/dark choco as topping
Pour into baking pan and bake @180 C for 30 mins
